我们四下观察，怪异的灵能束慢慢地排列成复杂的网格。精心的设计中逐渐显现出无法识别的密码。

它们开始慢慢地四处来回移动，依次形成越来越复杂的新形状。我们逐渐从中看出了规律；一种主导着它们运动的逻辑。

texts.en:
All around us the Shroud pulsates with the calming rhythms of the Golden Dream.

As we observe, errant wisps of psionic energy slowly arrange themselves into an intricate grid. Unrecognizable cyphers begin to manifest in carefully laid designs.

They begin to shuffle over and around each other, in turn forming new shapes of increasing complexity. In time, we sense a pattern; a logic, governing their motions.

We realize we are party to a game with the Golden Dream. Each move it guides us through instills us with a new sense of calming indulgence.

label.zh: 我们一边玩一边逃到有意义的地方去。
label.en: As we play, we escape to somewhere meaningful.
